intro.en: An agent is a model with instructions and tools, saved in Foundry under a name. Client apps call it by that name.
intro.ro: Agent model hai jis ke saath instructions aur tools hon, Foundry mein ek naam se mehfooz. Client apps usay usi naam se call karti hain.

text.en: Defined by configuration: model deployment, instructions, tools. No hosting code needed.
text.ro: Configuration se banta hai: model deployment, instructions, tools. Hosting code nahi chahiye.

text.en: File search, code interpreter, web search, functions, MCP and others give knowledge or actions.
text.ro: File search, code interpreter, web search, functions, MCP waghera ilm ya kaam dete hain.

text.en: Holds the chunks and embeddings of files that file search reads.
text.ro: Files ke chunks aur embeddings rakhta hai jo file search parhta hai.

text.en: Each saved change creates a new version of the agent.
text.ro: Har mehfooz tabdeeli agent ka naya version banati hai.

text.en: Stores the history of one chat. Use one per user session.
text.ro: Ek chat ki history rakhti hai. Har user session ke liye alag.

text.en: Ask a person before actions that cost money or change data.
text.ro: Paise lagne ya data badalne wale kaam se pehle insan se poochein.

text.en: Authenticates with Entra ID, opens a conversation, sends input and prints output_text.
text.ro: Entra ID se authenticate hoti hai, conversation kholti hai, input bhejti hai aur output_text dikhati hai.

text.en: The client holds no instructions and no model name. Both belong to the agent.
text.ro: Client mein na instructions hain na model ka naam. Dono agent ke paas hain.

example.code:
openai = project.get_openai_client(agent_name="hr-helper")
conversation = openai.conversations.create()
r = openai.responses.create(
    conversation=conversation.id, input="How many vacation days do I get?")
print(r.output_text)
openai.conversations.delete(conversation_id=conversation.id)

rows.en: Ready-made external tools over a standard

remember.en: Instructions say how to behave; tools decide what the agent can do.
remember.ro: Instructions rawaiya batati hain; tools tay karte hain ke agent kya kar sakta hai.

remember.en: Test in the agent playground and look at the tool calls.
remember.ro: Agent playground mein test karein aur tool calls dekhein.

remember.en: Function calling: the model asks, your app runs the function and returns the result.
remember.ro: Function calling: model maangta hai, aap ki app function chala kar nateeja deti hai.

remember.en: Give an agent only the tools and permissions that it needs.
remember.ro: Agent ko sirf zaroori tools aur permissions dein.

traps.en: One shared conversation mixes users; one agent can serve many conversations.
traps.ro: Ek mushtarka conversation users ko mila deti hai; ek agent kai conversations sambhalta hai.

traps.en: Code interpreter runs code in a sandbox; it does not search the web.
traps.ro: Code interpreter sandbox mein code chalata hai; web par talash nahi karta.
